org.asynchttpclient

Class RequestBuilder

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.asynchttpclient.RequestBuilderBase<RequestBuilder>
      • org.asynchttpclient.RequestBuilder

  • public class RequestBuilder
extends RequestBuilderBase<RequestBuilder>
    Builder for a Request. Warning: mutable and not thread-safe! Beware that it holds a reference to the Request instance it builds, so modifying the builder will modify the request even after it has been built.
